title.narrative: UNICEF Global Inclusive Education Programme: Strengthening Disability Inclusive Education Systems through Leadership and Monitoring

description.narrative: The project will support UNICEF's work on inclusive education through the efforts of the Leadership Council, a gathering of stakeholders committed to advancing inclusive education and emphasizing the participation of organizations of persons with disabilities. This is rooted in Norway's commitments under the Global Disability Summit in Berlin on April 25. Additionally, data and knowledge about progress globally and at the country level will be collected through the work of the Global Observatory, which will provide an overview of the status and progress in the field. Gender and the challenges of belonging to multiple marginalized groups will be addressed to cater for a truly inclusive environment.
